title: Zung Ying Nyi

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 715
Date 15/11/26

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

November 15th 1926

Sir,
    Thirty four Germans who were removed from the s.s.
China outside Woosung last February by a British cruiser
arrived here at noon 14th inst escorted by seven
members of the Hongkong Police. The prisoners who
were brought here by the P.& O. "Malta" were released
on arrival in Shanghai. Some of them are now staying
on board the interned ships in the river while others
are staying with friends and in hotels.
    The Arsenal Authorities will send 100 mauser
pistols to Peking to day for the use of the police
there.
    The painters held a meeting in their Guild on Park
Road at 2 p.m. 14th inst for the purpose of electing a
Committee for the coming year. They decided to retain
Zung Ying Nyi 陳引年 Li Soh Ts 李南之 and Zung Ching Lung 張青龍
as the officers of the Guild. There were 45 painters
present at the meeting which was orderly throughout.
One of the committee advocated that the painters
build their own guild house and suggested a piece of
vacant ground on Seward Road as a suitable site.
The meeting terminated at 6 p.m.
    The distribution of passage tickets continued at
General Li Tsung Woo's home yesterday when tickets were
given to about 30 rebels.
    Pah Vung Wei 白文蔚 the rebel leader entertained the
local military and civil officials to dinner in Ih Ts
Shang restaurant 一枝香 on Foochow Road on 14th inst.
The host made a speech thanking the officials for the
trouble they had taken in connection with the
repatriation scheme.

                        Your Obedient Servant,

                        W.Brewster

                        Detective Sub-Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事侦缉处
I. O. REG
第 715 号
日期 1926年11月15日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1926年11月15日

先生：
三十四名德国人于今年二月由一艘英国巡洋舰在吴淞口外从“中国”号轮船上带离，他们于本月14日中午由七名香港警察护送抵达此处。这些囚犯是由半岛及东方轮船公司（P.& O.）的“马耳他”号轮船载来，抵达上海后即被释放。其中一些人目前居住在江上被扣留的船只上，另一些人则借住在朋友家或旅馆中。
兵工厂当局将于今日向北京发送一百支毛瑟手枪，供当地警方使用。
油漆工于本月14日下午2时在派克路（Park Road）的公会举行会议，目的是选举下一年度的委员会。他们决定留任陈引年（Zung Ying Nyi）、李南之（Li Soh Ts）和张青龙（Zung Ching Lung）为公会职员。出席会议的油漆工有45人，会议全程秩序井然。委员会中的一名成员提议油漆工建造自己的公会会所，并建议将西华德路（Seward Road）上的一块空地作为合适选址。会议于下午6时结束。
昨日在李宗吾将军家中继续分发船票，约有30名反叛分子获得了船票。
反叛首领白文蔚（Pah Vung Wei）于本月14日在福州路的一枝香餐馆宴请当地军政官员。东道主发表讲话，感谢官员们在遣返计划中所付出的辛劳。

您顺从的仆人，

W. Brewster

侦探副督察。

警务处总监。

Form 2    34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Sinza    Station.
November 14 th    1916
REPORT ON    A Meeting at Painters    Guild 697 Park Road on the
14 th inst.
Made by    Det.Insp.Fitzgibbon.    Forwarded by Inspector Ramsay.

Sir,
From 2 to 4.30 p.m. on the 14 th
instant a meeting was held by 45 Journeymen Painters at
their Guild 697 Park Road, Zung Nyi Nyi (张引年) presiding, &
after the new rules governing the Establishment were discussed
they were passed unanimously .
The President introduced Eight new clauses with a view of
getting a Hospital for their sick & to raise funds towards
the upkeep of members who through illness or injury in the
course of their employment are unable to earn a livelihood.
The necessary funds to be raised by the workmen themselves.
The Eight new motions having been favourably received by
those present were deferred to a future date.
Zung Nyi Nyi Chairman of the Committee representing journey-
men painters says he sent invitations to the Masters Guild
in the City but nobody from there attended the meeting which
was conducted in an orderly manner.
Another meeting will take place at 697 Park Road on 16th
instant, time not stated, when the Ningpo, Soochow, Shaoxing
Shaoshing & Shanghai members intend to appoint their respective
head men.

yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon
Det.Insp.
Chief Inspector Ramsay.

表格 2    34
上海警务处。
新闸捕房。
1916年11月14日
关于    本月14日在派克路697号油漆工公会举行的会议的报告。
报告人    侦探督察菲茨吉本（Fitzgibbon）。    转呈人 拉姆齐督察（Ramsay）。

先生：
本月14日下午2时至4时30分，45名油漆工匠在派克路697号他们的公会举行会议，由张引年（Zung Nyi Nyi）主持，在讨论了管理该机构的新规章后，这些规章获得一致通过。
会长提出了八项新条款，旨在为其病患建立一所医院，并筹集资金以维持那些因疾病或在受雇期间受伤而无法谋生的会员的生活。所需资金由工人自行筹集。
这八项新动议受到与会者的欢迎，但被推迟到日后处理。
代表油漆工匠的委员会主席张引年（Zung Nyi Nyi）称，他曾向城内的师傅公会发出邀请，但无人出席此次会议，会议进行得秩序井然。
另一次会议将于本月16日在派克路697号举行，时间未定，届时宁波、苏州、绍兴和上海籍的成员打算任命各自的首领。

您顺从的，
莫里斯·菲茨吉本
侦探督察
首席督察拉姆齐。
